management_steps.details: Sublingual tablets (5 mg) or oral tablets (20-30 mg).
Sublingual: 5 mg, may be repeated if required at 5-minute intervals for 3 or 4 doses. Oral: 20-30 mg twice daily (taken at 8:00 and 14:00 to provide a nitrate-free period).
Keep tablets in airtight and lightproof container. Not addictive. Use prophylactically before activities that may provoke angina.
